text: Kitchen 18x25 & Dish 13x13 Towels, Blue & White, 8 Pack by J&M Home Fashions 70327A. I am trying to figure out the 4 and 5 star reviews, the only thing I am coming up with is there must be different manufacturing mills because the set I got are nothing like those great reviews. Mine are stiff, rough and not absorbent, I can't say what they are made with but they are unlike any dish towel or dish cloth I have used.
